Why get fit at AVID?

01 / AVID GOLF

Your swing comes first.

Start with your current clubs, your goals and your budget. Compare the options against how you actually swing.

02 / AVID GOLF

See the difference.

Launch monitor feedback helps compare launch, spin, carry and consistency. A fitting makes equipment decisions easier to understand.

03 / AVID GOLF

Local expertise.

Work with AVID fitters Tyler Polanski and Colin McMahon in a comfortable indoor setting. Ask questions, test options and leave with a clear direction.

From first swing to final spec.

  1. Book your sessionChoose a fitting and available appointment in Acuity.
  2. Establish your baselineTalk through your game and assess your current setup.
  3. Hit. Compare. Refine.Test combinations and review the numbers with your fitter.
  4. Find your fitUnderstand the equipment specifications that suit your swing.
